definitions.gloss: traffic lane; lane on a road
definitions.explanation: A marked division of a road for a single line of traffic. Used when talking about highways, multi-lane roads, and driving.

examples.japanese: {右|みぎ}の{車線|しゃせん}に{移|うつ}った。
examples.english: I moved to the right lane.

examples.japanese: この{道路|どうろ}は{片側|かたがわ}{三|さん}{車線|しゃせん}ある。
examples.english: This road has three lanes on each side.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}のため{一|いち}{車線|しゃせん}が{規制|きせい}されている。
examples.english: One lane is restricted due to construction.

notes:
{車線|しゃせん} refers to a marked lane on a road for a single line of traffic. Composed of {車|しゃ} (vehicle) + {線|せん} (line).

COUNTING:
Used as a counter-like word to describe the number of lanes:
- {二|に}{車線|しゃせん} (two lanes)
- {三|さん}{車線|しゃせん} (three lanes)
- {片側|かたがわ}{二|に}{車線|しゃせん} (two lanes on each side)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車線|しゃせん}{変更|へんこう}: lane change
- {追|お}い{越|こ}し{車線|しゃせん}: passing lane (right lane in Japan)
- {走行|そうこう}{車線|しゃせん}: driving lane (left lane in Japan)
- {車線|しゃせん}{規制|きせい}: lane restriction

NOTE:
Homophone: {斜線|しゃせん} (diagonal line) uses different kanji and has a completely different meaning.
